user.title: Learn a new pattern
user.description: Pick the entity whose behaviour should be learned. A power sensor works best, because it shows when a device is really being used.

source.title: When is it active?
source.description: Define when {entity} counts as active. The times at which it becomes active and inactive are what gets learned.

data_description.active_above: The entity counts as active while its value is above this.
data_description.active_states: The entity counts as active while it is in one of these states. You can type your own.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Filters out short spikes and dips.

control.title: What should be switched?
control.description: Leave the entities empty to only learn and predict without switching anything.

data.guard_entity: Don't switch off while this is active
data.guard_grace_minutes: Switch off after being unused for
data.condition_entity: Only switch on while this is active

data_description.lead_minutes: Minutes before the learned switch-on time.
data_description.off_delay_minutes: Minutes after the learned switch-off time.
data_description.guard_entity: Optional. If empty, the entity that is learned from is used, unless it is switched itself.
data_description.guard_above: Optional. For a numeric entity: counts as in use while above this value.
data_description.guard_grace_minutes: When a switch-off was postponed because of use, it happens once the entity was unused for this long.
data_description.condition_entity: Optional. For example a person or a presence sensor.

data_description.window_days: Older data is forgotten and recent days count more, so the model follows slow changes on its own.
data_description.min_days: Nothing is predicted before this many complete days were observed. It is also how many days are needed to tell weekdays apart.
data_description.min_confidence: A period counts as a habit when the model is at least this sure the entity is active.
data_description.import_history: Uses what the recorder already knows about the entity, so there is no waiting.
